pages.text: $(bold)All systems operational$()$(br2)The stations pass the structure checks. Insert a charged cell on the initiating side and select Energize.
pages.title: Ready

pages.text: $(bold)No frequency detected$()$(br2)Craft two unlinked computers with one Essence of Entanglement between them. Replace the installed computers with the resulting pair.
pages.title: Missing Frequency

pages.text: $(bold)Entangled counterpart not found$()$(br2)Check that the paired computer is placed in the same dimension. Compare the Frequency tooltips before placing the pair.
pages.title: Missing Counterpart

pages.text: $(bold)Entangled counterpart is errored$()$(br2)Open the other computer and read its own status. Correct its pylon setup or other reported problem before trying again.
pages.title: Counterpart Error

pages.text: $(bold)Incomplete pylon system$()$(br2)Put a properly configured Observer-Dependent base on each cardinal arm at computer level, one to eight blocks away. Gold faces inward and Obsidian fills the other five faces.
pages.title: Missing Pylons

pages.text: $(bold)Misaligned pylon heights$()$(br2)Check all four pylons at the station reporting this error. Make them equally tall with uninterrupted Obsidian directly above each base.
pages.title: Uneven Pylons

pages.text: $(bold)Pylon distances with counterpart differ$()$(br2)Compare north with north, east with east, south with south, and west with west. Match the base distance on every arm at both stations.
pages.title: Different Offsets

pages.text: $(bold)Pylon heights with counterpart differ$()$(br2)Both stations need the same pylon height. Count each base as the first block and match the number of Obsidian blocks above it.
pages.title: Different Heights

pages.text: $(bold)A station or region is unloaded$()$(br2)Bring both stations and every chunk touched by the swap into loaded range. Reduce the distance or keep a second player nearby.
pages.title: Unloaded Region

pages.text: $(bold)A region is outside the world bounds$()$(br2)Rebuild within the world border and build height. Check the full interior and its top layer, including any corners that extend past the border.
pages.title: World Bounds

pages.text: $(bold)The two regions overlap$()$(br2)Move one station farther away. The two complete interior footprints need to be separate.
pages.title: Overlapping Regions

pages.text: $(bold)A region contains a qBlock or block entity$()$(br2)Remove all qBlocks and blocks such as chests, furnaces, hoppers, or extra computers from both interiors.
pages.title: Unsupported Cargo

pages.text: $(bold)Insert a charged Coolant Cell$()$(br2)Put charged coolant in the initiating computer. $(l:qcraft:computers/coolant)Refill a used cell$(/l) with Blue Ice when needed.
pages.title: Missing Coolant

pages.text: $(bold)The region swap failed$()$(br2)The block exchange did not finish. Check both regions and retry with a small test area of ordinary solid blocks. If it recurs, share the server log and station layout with the operator.
pages.title: Swap Failed
